subject: environmental-science
title: Reducing Footprints
welcome_lead: Behaviour change, electrification, efficiency — what really cuts kg CO₂e?
meta_desc: A-Level Environmental Science adventure on personal and corporate footprint reduction.
final_note: The biggest wedges are usually heating, transport and diet — not plastic straws.

concepts.def: Ranks mitigation options by cost per tonne CO₂e.
Reducing energy per unit service (e.g., insulation, heat pumps).
Diet, transport mode, flying frequency, household energy use.
Payment for emission reductions elsewhere; quality varies widely.
Reductions within a company's own value chain, not external offsets.

walkthroughs.body_html: Many efficiency measures (LEDs, insulation) have negative cost — save money over lifetime.
Switching to plant-rich diets can cut food footprint 50%. Beef and dairy dominate land-use emissions.
Many forest offset projects have been found to over-credit. Insetting within supply chains is increasingly favoured.
